result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge, and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off by the viewport, including its restaurant name and delivery price. The text is hard-clipped rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel card widths, gaps, and right padding so the visible card content is not clipped. If partial cards are used as a scroll cue, keep their text hidden until the card is brought fully into view.

issues.description: A partially visible, unlabeled category chip appears at the far right of the filter row, which looks like a broken or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient trailing padding and use a more deliberate carousel peek width, or ensure enough of the next chip and its label remains visible.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant image, hiding feed content behind an opaque bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom inset or scroll-container padding equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so content can scroll fully above it.
